rationale: I acted on the hypothesis that the pLayer permutation formula was wrong in the previous version — specifically that the standard PRESENT bit permutation P(i) = 16*(i mod 4) + floor(i/4) was being applied incorrectly — and replaced it with the well-known equivalent formulation `tmp[(i*16) % 63] = b[i]` (with bit 63 fixed), which correctly implements the PRESENT-80 P-layer. I also adjusted the round-count terminal condition from `ROUNDS-1` (30) to `ROUNDS` (31) so that exactly 31 full rounds plus one final key-addition are performed, matching the PRESENT-80 specification. If this repair also fails, I would next carefully trace the bit-serial load ordering (MSB-first vs. LSB-first for both key and plaintext), verify the key-schedule round-counter values passed (1-based vs. 0-based, and whether the key used in each round is updated before or after the XOR), and cross-check against a known PRESENT-80 test vector step by step to isolate exactly which stage produces the wrong value.
